gen-fs-oswald-fs-hoover: Tight, strong rows up top. Hoover follows in serif form, with a generous eye in the e and short ascenders, so a long page of text feels refined and sturdy rather than crowded.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-chakra-petch: Chakra Petch reads contemporary, its round letters cupped rather than clenched and its strokes held to one width. Oswald, meanwhile, packs confident, tightly knit rows into a heading, and the body font keeps things professional with its uniform line.
gen-fs-pilcrow-rounded-fs-karma: Pilcrow Rounded sets friendly, tightly packed letters with a lowercase as dense as poured lead type. Karma comes in behind as a trustworthy text serif, its terminals finishing clear of the stem and its strokes thinning gently.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-archivo: Pramukh Rounded packs its glyphs close, with bowls tipped open like a ladle, and it looks best big and brief. Archivo follows in the same spirit, a sans with curves that open outward and a commanding x-height.
gen-fs-rajdhani-newsreader: Authoritative is the mood Newsreader gives the body, while Rajdhani above it stays clean and modern with tightly woven lines. Newsreader then carries a long page as a text serif with restrained stress and open jaws on its curves.
gen-fs-ranade-fs-karma: Ranade leads with small-looking capitals and big, wide-tracked lowercase. Karma, a trustworthy text serif with terminals clear of the stem, is happiest at a modest size, where its gentle modulation never snags the eye.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-clash-grotesk: Approachable and clean, Clash Grotesk skips thick-and-thin modulation entirely. Red Hat Display adds a bold, marker-like heading with daylight in every curve, and the sans-serif body can sit at a modest size without losing that friendliness.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-roundo: Roundo reads geometric and tidy, its n built with arch and stem matching. Red Hat Display is the bolder voice, with a marker-like line and open curves, while the sans-serif body keeps every small counter unclogged.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-domine: Red Hat Display draws a bold, marker-like line with daylight inside every curve. Domine, a dignified serif, answers with compact ascenders over tall lowercase and a slight pinch where curves meet stems, making the heading look best big and brief.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-faculty-glyphi: Faculty Glyphic reads modern, with clear openings in its rounded letters. Red Hat Display brings a bold, wire-like line that shines in a heading, while the body font stays low and quiet beneath it.
